payload.title: [Table 1] Proximity of PMIP3 traces to LMR ensembles
payload.description: This workflow applies the concept of plume distance to PMIP3 simulations and the offline Last Millennium Reanalysis (LMR) to reproduce Table 1 from a related paper. It involves loading and processing climate data from various sources, including PMIP3 and LMR datasets, and resampling ensemble trajectories using different statistical models. The workflow calculates and compares plume distances between different climate model outputs and presents the results in a structured format.
